name: terminal
title: Terminal
blurb: Terminal animates typing commands with syntax highlighting and keyboard sounds.
description: Simulates a bash terminal session, typing commands character-by-character with syntax highlighting and optional audio feedback from Web Audio API.
use_when: Hero sections or documentation featuring CLI workflows need an engaging, interactive demo.
avoid_when: Touch-only surfaces or contexts where keyboard sounds are unwanted; no prefers-reduced-motion handling.
a11y: Terminal output renders to the DOM and is screen-reader accessible. Audio plays via Web Audio API; prefers-reduced-motion is ignored.
